stories.title: Hospital face mask rule as critical incident ends
stories.summary: The trust says there has been a rise in respiratory illnesses among patients, visitors and staff.

stories.title: Man jailed for drugging then abusing girlfriend
stories.summary: The abuse was discovered after he sent WhatsApp messages to a sex worker.

stories.title: Coroner's safety plea after death of man at lake
stories.summary: Panashe Muchenje, 19, went to the lake with two friends but disappeared under the surface.

stories.title: Protesters disrupt Sir Paul Smith's book talk
stories.summary: The fashion firm says it is committed to animal welfare following protests at a book tour event.

stories.title: 'Urgent need' to improve relationships at council
stories.summary: Government envoys say senior councillors and staff "urgently" need to get on better.

stories.title: Government scraps plans to upgrade A46 bypass
stories.summary: It says the scheme, which was expected to cost up to £500m, is "no longer affordable".

stories.title: Muslim convert used 'lads' holiday' chat to join IS
stories.summary: Oliver William Rea admits "preparing terrorist acts" by trying to join the Islamic State group.

stories.title: Van driver's lift helps officer catch wanted thief
stories.summary: When a passing builder stopped and asked if he could assist, officer Steve Dennis jumped in, police say.

stories.title: Mystery letter to student found during hall refurb
stories.summary: An old, handwritten letter from a mum to her son has been found during a building refurbishment.

stories.title: Inquiry call over decision to declare city 'bankrupt'
stories.summary: Nottingham City Council issued a notice in 2023 after declaring it could not balance its books.

stories.title: Police make arrest in rape investigation
stories.summary: Nottinghamshire Police arrest a man in connection with a rape near a rail line in Newark.

stories.title: MP 'treated with disdain' by 'toxic' maternity unit
stories.summary: MP Michelle Welsh describes her experience giving birth to her son in Nottingham as "horrific".
